relationships.basis: George Glasgow-638 is already described in his held and live biography as the Crawford child of William Glasgow and Janet Thomson, but neither parent profile is attached. The inspected Scotland baptism index names that exact couple for George, born 8 June 1818 and baptised 14 June at Crawford. An exact-parent search returned thirteen Crawford entries spanning 1802–1828, including Isabel in 1808 and an older George in 1810. The inspected monumental-inscription transcript identifies William Glasgow-2715, gamekeeper to the Earl of Hopetoun, his wife Janet Thomson, their daughter Isabel (died 1881 aged 73), and an older George who died in July 1816. The 1841 census transcript places gamekeeper William with Janet and Isabella at Hass, Crawford; the 1851 transcript gives widower William, 72, born Crawford, with daughter Isabella and younger children. This combination supports the gamekeeper as the 1818 child’s father, with reuse of the deceased child’s name. The proposed attachment to the later Leicester adult is assessed at 88% subjective confidence, including the unresolved childhood-to-adult identification.

relationships.limitations: The baptism and census originals and gravestone image have not been inspected; these are provider index/transcript readings. FamilySearch and Findmypast reproduce the same underlying baptism index and are not independent evidence. The later Leicester adult’s exact birthday may derive from the baptism, so it is not counted as independent confirmation. His inspected 1843 GRO marriage index locates a Leicester entry with Mary Ann Norton among the same-page spouse possibilities, but gives no father or father’s occupation. The original marriage is the decisive next test. The memorial’s older George, died 1816 aged 7, cannot be the 1818 child; its reported age differs by about a year from the 1810 baptism and remains unresolved. Some sibling index birth fields contain malformed years and the 1806 John dates conflict; none is silently corrected. William Glasgow-1533, the circa-1795 Glasgow-born weaver with a Janet Thomson wife, remains a distinct comparison rather than being excluded merely for missing fields: the gamekeeper’s 1841/1851 Crawford household, older age, trade, wife and Isabel chronology provide the positive match. No exact vital replacement, mother attachment, profile merger or upstream father is inferred.

relationships.basis: Thomas Glasgow-3329 is recorded in the 1861 census at Crawford, Lanarkshire, with a birth about 1814. The Ancestry Scotland, Select Births and Baptisms index records Thomas Glasgow born 11 March 1813 and baptised at Crawford on 21 March 1813 to William and Janet (https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60143/records/13622746). William and Janet were the only Glasgow couple baptising at Crawford in these years (Robert 1802, John 1804 and 1806, Isabel 1808, George 1810, Thomas 1813, William 1815, Jean 1816 and later children to 1828). The Leadhills (Crawford parish) monument of Janet Thomson, spouse of William Glasgow, gamekeeper to the Earl of Hopetoun (ancestry-62497-370985), names her son George who died in 1816 aged 7 and Isabel Glasgow who died in 1881 aged 73, matching the 1810 and 1808 baptisms, so the Crawford couple is William Glasgow-2715 and Janet Thomson. Thomas's father is attached as William-2715 at 75% probable.

The index row gives the mother's forename only. The monument does not name Thomas. William-2715's own birth (about 1781, from his 1853 death aged 71) and father are unknown. A separate William Glasgow-1533, born 1795 in Barony, is also recorded as husband of a Janet Thomson; he is too young to be the father of the 1802 Crawford child and is not identified with William-2715. No mother is inferred.
